function.description: Retire an operator's blanket approval over one NFT collection (setApprovalForAll -> false). This can only REDUCE risk: it grants nothing and moves nothing. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_nft_revoke_approval

chain.description: Chain to nft_revoke_approval on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas and per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

operator.description: The operator whose blanket approval over this collection is retired. This can only REDUCE risk.

why.description: Why this act, now (one line). Required on an autonomous run; the owner reads it.
